Class GuiGameCreationScreen

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.Screen
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.gui.guiScreens.GuiScreen
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.gui.guiScreens.GuiGameCreationScreen
public class GuiGameCreationScreen extends GuiScreen
GUI screen for creating a new game. This screen allows the user to select game settings such as flight level and the number of players before starting a new game session.

      public javafx.scene.layout.Pane getNode()
